plugin.name: gtkdecor
plugin._long: Server side decorations that copy the look of a GTK/Adwaita header bar, so that Qt, old GTK and other toolkits which do not draw their own decorations blend in with the rest of the desktop. Replaces the built-in "decoration" plugin: enable one or the other, never both.

option.name: title_height
option._long: Height of the title bar in pixels, top border excluded. 37 matches a GTK header bar.

option.name: border_size
option._long: Thickness of the window border in pixels.

option.name: corner_radius
option._long: Radius of the two top corners in pixels. Only the top corners can be rounded: the bottom ones belong to the client, which draws them square.

option.name: button_size
option._long: Diameter of the round title bar buttons in pixels.

option.name: button_padding
option._long: Gap between the buttons and the window edge, in pixels.

option.name: button_spacing
option._long: Gap between two adjacent buttons, in pixels.

option.name: shadow_size
option._long: How far the drop shadow reaches out of the window, in pixels. Set it to 0 to drop no shadow at all. Maximised, tiled and fullscreen windows never cast one.

option.name: shadow_offset
option._long: How far down the shadow is pushed, in pixels, as if the light came from above the window.

option.name: font
option._long: Font used for the window title. GTK header bars use the interface font in bold.

option.name: button_order
option._long: Which buttons to show and in which order, out of "minimize", "maximize" and "close". Leave it as just "close" to match the GNOME/Ubuntu button layout.

option.name: active_color
option._long: Background of the title bar of the focused window.

option.name: inactive_color
option._long: Background of the title bar of unfocused windows.

option.name: border_color
option._long: Color of the hairline around the window.

option.name: highlight_color
option._long: Color of the light line drawn just inside the top border.

option.name: separator_color
option._long: Color of the line between the title bar and the window contents.

option.name: font_color
option._long: Color of the title and of the button icons of the focused window.

option.name: inactive_font_color
option._long: Color of the title and of the button icons of unfocused windows.

option.name: shadow_color
option._long: Color of the drop shadow of the focused window. Its alpha is what sets how dark the shadow gets.

option.name: inactive_shadow_color
option._long: Color of the drop shadow of unfocused windows. A fainter shadow than the focused one is what makes the focused window look closer.

option.name: button_color
option._long: Color of the round background of a button at rest. Its alpha is multiplied by 1.8 while hovered and by 2.6 while pressed. Use a translucent white instead of black for dark themes.

option.name: ignore_views
option._short: Decoration disabled for specified window types
option._long: Disables window decoration for windows matching the specified criteria.

option.name: forced_views
option._short: Force decorations for specified window types
option._long: Forces window decoration for windows matching the specified criteria, overriding client decoration preference.
